skirmish.module.custom_sky.name: Custom Sky
skirmish.module.custom_sky.description: Replaces the overworld sky itself — only on your screen. The vanilla sky, sun, moon and clouds are not drawn: each sky has its own day and night gradient, its own sun and moon (the moon keeps its phase), and the fog takes the horizon colour so the land fades into the new sky. Ten skies: nebula, Milky Way, northern lights, quasar, black hole, synthwave, eternal sunset, blood moon, alien world with a ringed giant and meteor shower.
skirmish.module.custom_sky.setting.prese: Which sky replaces the normal one
Always — the sky is replaced day and night (with its own day and night). Night — the normal sky by day, the new one fades in at dusk
skirmish.module.custom_sky.setting.hide_: Do not draw the vanilla clouds (the game option is untouched)
skirmish.module.custom_sky.setting.fog.t: Distant fog takes the new sky's horizon colour — no seam between land and sky
skirmish.module.custom_sky.setting.sun_m: Own sun and moon where the game has them (the moon with phases)
skirmish.module.custom_sky.setting.inten: How brightly stars, nebulae and the rest glow
